notes: Check points judged by the survey standard: pick the feature (DTM spot shots, kerbing, road surface, pipes, rail, photogrammetry...) and GeoWorks applies the rule that 80% of the check points must be within 3x the feature's height accuracy (2x for photogrammetry), plus the contour rule (80% within 0.2x the interval). On Stake-out (staked vs surface and the check sections sheet) and on Scan > Register (the control check and the accuracy report).
